traits.alien.name: Alien
traits.alien.description:
§oThe stats feel off...§r
..as if they're changing! Maybe time will tell?
traits.aquadynamic.name: Aquadynamic
traits.aquadynamic.description:
§oIt's getting wet in here!§r
The tool is unhindered by water and loves rainy evenings.
traits.aridiculous.name: Aridiculous
traits.aridiculous.description:
§oTurn up the heat!§r
The tool works better in hotter environments.
traits.autosmelt.name: Autosmelt
traits.autosmelt.description:
§oA furnace in tool form!§r
Harvested blocks get smelted.
traits.baconlicious.name: Baconlicious
traits.coldblooded.name: Cold-Blooded
traits.coldblooded.description:
§oSavage!§r
Deal increased damage to targets at full health.
traits.crude.name: Crude
traits.crude.description:
§oArmor is for cowards!§r
Bonus damage against unarmored targets.
traits.crumbling.name: Crumbling
traits.crumbling.description:
§oCrumble rumble rumble§r
The tool breaks soft blocks that don't need a tool faster.
traits.dense.name: Dense
traits.dense.description:
§oHard...er.§r
Your tool lasts longer when it has less durability.
traits.depthdigger.name: Depth Digger
traits.depthdigger.description:
§oMiner's Friend!§r
Your tool mines faster the deeper you mine.
traits.duritos.name: Duritae
traits.duritos.description:
§oDoesn't taste as good as it sounds.§r
Your tool lasts longer ...most of the time.
traits.enderference.name: Enderference
traits.enderference.description:
§oAnti-Teleport!§r
Prevents Endermen from teleporting around for a short time.
traits.established.name: Well-Established
traits.established.description:
§oFree bonus XP!§r
You gain additional XP.
traits.flammable.name: Flammable
traits.flammable.description:
§oCan't have enough fire!§r
Blocking blocks fire damage and getting hit sets the attacker on fire.
traits.fractured.name: Fractured
traits.heavy.name: Heavy
traits.hellish.name: Hellish
traits.hellish.description:
§oFrom down below!§r
Deal bonus damage to non-Nether mobs.
traits.holy.name: Holy
traits.holy.description:
§oRadiant!§r
Deal bonus damage to undead enemies.
traits.insatiable.name: Insatiable
traits.insatiable.description:
§oDevour!§r
During combat you deal more and more damage but also consume more and more durability.
traits.jagged.name: Jagged
traits.jagged.description:
§oMoves like jagged!§r
Every point durability lost increases damage.
traits.lightweight.name: Lightweight
traits.lightweight.description:
§oSwift like the wind!§r
Increases the overall speed of your tool when mining and attacking.
traits.magnetic.name: Magnetic
traits.magnetic.description:
§oHow do they work?!§r
Hitting things attracts nearby things?!
traits.momentum.name: Momentum
traits.momentum.description:
§oFaster, keep going!§r
Mining blocks increases your speed, as long as you keep going.
traits.petramor.name: Petramor
traits.petramor.description:
§oSo much stone, must see it all!§r
Your tool loves stone, it literally wants to absorb it (for durability).
traits.poisonous.name: Poisonous
traits.poisonous.description:
§oNot exactly lead-free!§r
Poisons enemies on hit.
traits.prickly.name: Prickly
traits.prickly.description:
§oOuch!§r
Nobody is safe from those thorns, they always hurt.
traits.raging.name: Raging
traits.raging.description:
§oA desperate solution!§r
Your tool does more damage the lower your health is.
traits.sharp.name: Sharp
traits.sharp.description:
§oCan even cut words!§r
Hitting an enemy leaves them bleeding for a short time.
traits.shocking.name: Shocking
traits.shocking.description:
§oBzzzzzt!§r
Running around, breaking blocks or hitting things charges your tool. Hitting an enemy discharges it, dealing damage and providing a speed boost. Mining a block discharges it, giving a mining speed boost.
traits.slimey_green.name: Slimey
traits.slimey_blue.name: Slimey
traits.spiky.name: Spiky
traits.spiky.description:
§o200% cooler with spikes!§r
Blocking and getting hurt deals damage to the attacker.
traits.splintering.name: Splintering
traits.splintering.description:
§oA souvenir for your enemies!§r
Hit them more to deal more damage.
traits.splinters.name: Splinters
traits.splinters.description:
§oOuch!§r
Be careful not to catch a splinter!
traits.squeaky.name: Squeaky
traits.squeaky.description:
§oCute.§r
Your tool is so soft and squeaky it gained silktouch, but deals no damage.
traits.superheat.name: Superheat
traits.superheat.description:
§oTurn up the heat!§r
Deal bonus damage to enemies on fire.
traits.stiff.name: Stiff
traits.stiff.description:
§oUnmoving!§r
Blocking reduces the damage taken even more.
traits.stonebound.name: Stonebound
traits.stonebound.description:
§oYour tool absolutely loves stone!§r
The tool mines faster as it wears out, but does less damage.
traits.tasty.name: Tasty
traits.tasty.description:
§oOm Nom Nom§r
Smells so good.. You'd rather eat your tool than starve.
traits.unnatural.name: Unnatural
traits.unnatural.description:
§oAbomination!§r
The tool mines faster the higher its mining level is above the required one.
traits.writable.name: Writable
traits.writable.description:
§oIntellectual!§r
More words. More Modifiers. It's only logical!
traits.breakable.name: Breakable
traits.breakable.description:
§oThis side up!§r
Projectiles have a 50% chance to break on impact.
traits.endspeed.name: Endspeed
traits.endspeed.description:
§oQuantum speed!§r
Projectiles instantly travel to their destination.
traits.freezing.name: Freezing
traits.freezing.description:
§oWinter is Coming§r
Successful hits slow your target more and more.
traits.hovering.name: Hovering
traits.hovering.description:
§oFree like the wind§r
Projectiles move slower but don't mind gravity as much.
traits.splitting.name: Splitting
traits.splitting.description:
§oTwo for one!§r
The sudden acceleration of releasing an arrow might cause it to split into two.

message.tconstruct.moss_levels: At least 5 experience levels are required.
tooltip.tconstruct.slimesling: Charge while standing on the ground and aiming at a block, then release to fling yourself backwards.
tooltip.tconstruct.slime_boots: Bounce on landing without fall damage. Sneak to stop bouncing and reduce fall damage.
tooltip.tconstruct.piggybackpack: Right-click a creature to carry it. Remove the pack to release passengers.
message.tconstruct.piggyback.full: There is no more room to carry passengers.
message.tconstruct.piggyback.inventory_f: There is not enough inventory space or enough packs.
tooltip.tconstruct.slime_channel: Placement selects flow direction; sneak to reverse it. Redstone stops the flow.
tooltip.tconstruct.spaghetti: Refill with wheat in a tool station. Add beetroot soup, then three different cooked meats.
